d:
BPSC Recruitment Cancelled: bihar men medikal shiksha ke kshetr men sarkari naukri ki taiyari kar rahe abhyarthiyon ko bara jhatka laga hai. bihar lok seva aayog ne asistent prophesar ki niyukti se jure vigyapan sankhya 04/2025 se lekar 28/2025 tak ke sabhi vigyapnon ko philhal radd kar diya hai. in vigyapnon ke madhyam se rajy ke sarkari medikal kolejon aur aspatalon men 1,711 asistent prophesron ki niyukti honi thi. vigyapan radd hone ke bad ab bharti prakriya nae sire se shuru karne ki taiyari hai.
